bank.prompt: What gave the Brisbane suburb of Chapel Hill its name?

options.label: A small timber chapel built on the hill
A sandstone chapel carved into the hillside

bank.reveal: A Primitive Methodist chapel was built there in 1875. By the 1880s the district was known as Chapel Hill after the chapel standing on the hill.

bank.prompt: The face of Brisbane City Hall's clock is closest to which width?
bank.reveal: Each City Hall clock face is almost five metres across, with minute hands about three metres long.

source.title: Brisbane City Hall and King George Square

bank.prompt: Which Brisbane shopping centre opened first?
bank.reveal: Chermside's drive-in shopping centre opened in 1957, ten years before Toombul opened in 1967.

bank.prompt: Which Brisbane housing style was made much harder to build by an 1885 land-subdivision law?
bank.reveal: The 1885 Undue Subdivision of Land Prevention Act imposed minimum street frontages and effectively stopped most new terrace rows, helping explain why Brisbane has fewer terraces than Sydney or Melbourne.

bank.prompt: Queensland's first experimental television broadcast was transmitted in 1934 from which Brisbane landmark?
bank.reveal: In 1934, Allen Campbell and Thomas Elliott transmitted Queensland's first experimental television broadcast from the Old Windmill Tower.

source.title: Brisbane City Centre Heritage Place Trail

bank.prompt: Stones Corner was named after which of these?
bank.reveal: James Stone bought land at the corner in 1875 and ran a small refreshment business there. The place became known as Stone's Corner.

bank.prompt: The name Herston combines the surnames of which two early Queensland figures?
bank.reveal: Herston blends part of Herbert with part of Bramston. Robert Herbert and John Bramston shared a house in the area called Herston House.

bank.prompt: Which became part of Brisbane life first?

options.label: New Farm Park opening as a Council park

bank.reveal: New Farm Park began operating as a Council park in 1914. The Story Bridge opened in 1940, twenty-six years later.

source.title: About New Farm Park; Council history

bank.prompt: Before it became an arts venue, Brisbane Powerhouse generated electricity mainly for what?
bank.reveal: The New Farm powerhouse supplied electricity for Brisbane's tram network and also powered lighting in several suburbs before it was decommissioned in 1971.

bank.prompt: How long did St John's Cathedral take to complete after its foundation stone was laid?
bank.reveal: The foundation stone was laid in 1901 and St John's Cathedral was completed in 2009 — a 108-year build.
